name: Housecall Pro
description: Housecall Pro field service software from any AI agent: customers and addresses, jobs with line items, appointments and schedules, invoices, estimates and their options, leads, employees, booking windows and the price book. Creates customers, jobs, estimates and leads and schedules work. Needs the MAX plan.
instructions:
## Housecall Pro
This connector calls the **Housecall Pro public API** (`https://api.housecallpro.com`), the field service software for home service businesses: customers and their addresses, jobs with line items and appointments, invoices, estimates, leads, employees, schedule availability and the price book.

**Requirements**: API access is available **only on the Housecall Pro MAX plan**, and only an **Admin** user can create an API key. Without the MAX plan the API Key Management app does not appear.

**Setup (about 3 minutes)**
1. Sign in to Housecall Pro as an Admin and open **My Apps > All Apps** (App Store).
2. Find **API Key Management**, open it and click **Generate API Key**.
3. Name the key and choose **Full access** (needed for the create and update tools) or **Read-only**, then **Generate key**.
4. Paste the key into `HOUSECALL_PRO_API_KEY` (the key only, without the word Token). It reaches all data of the account, so store it like a password; delete it in the same app to revoke it.

**Authentication**: every call sends `Authorization: Token <API key>`. A `401` means the key is wrong, was deleted, or the account is no longer on the MAX plan. A read-only key answers `403` on writes.

**Where to start**: `housecall_pro_get_company` checks the connection and returns the company, its time zone and its locations. Then `housecall_pro_list_customers` (search with `q`), `housecall_pro_list_jobs` and `housecall_pro_list_invoices`.

**Ids**: Housecall Pro ids are strings with a prefix: customers `cus_...`, jobs `job_...`, employees `pro_...`; invoices are uuids. Pass them unchanged.

**Money is in cents**: `total_amount`, `subtotal`, `outstanding_balance`, `amount`, `due_amount`, `unit_price` and `unit_cost` are integers in cents (`12500` = 125.00 in the company currency). Send prices in cents too.

**Pagination**: list tools take `page` (from 1) and `page_size` (10 when left out; up to 100 works well). The answer carries `page`, `page_size`, `total_pages` and `total_items`; call again with the next `page` until it equals `total_pages`. The price book answers with `total_pages_count`. `housecall_pro_list_job_line_items`, `housecall_pro_list_job_appointments` and `housecall_pro_list_job_invoices` return the whole list at once.

**Filters and dates**: date filters take ISO 8601 date-times (`2026-11-01T00:00:00Z`). The jobs filter `work_status` takes `unscheduled`, `scheduled`, `in_progress`, `completed`, `canceled`, while a job object shows its status as text (`needs scheduling`, `scheduled`, `in progress`, `complete rated`, `complete unrated`, `user canceled`, `pro canceled`). Multi-location accounts can narrow lists with `location_ids` (from `housecall_pro_get_company`).

**Workflows**
- Customer lookup: `housecall_pro_list_customers`, `housecall_pro_get_customer`, `housecall_pro_list_customer_addresses`; add or change customers with `housecall_pro_create_customer` and `housecall_pro_update_customer`.
- Jobs: `housecall_pro_list_jobs` (by schedule, customer, employees, status), `housecall_pro_get_job`, `housecall_pro_list_job_line_items`, `housecall_pro_list_job_appointments`, `housecall_pro_list_job_invoices`.
- Book work: `housecall_pro_create_job` needs a customer id and one of its address ids; set the job type (`job_fields.job_type_id`) from `housecall_pro_list_job_types` and employees from `housecall_pro_list_employees`. Then `housecall_pro_update_job_schedule` (single-visit jobs) or `housecall_pro_create_job_appointment` (extra visits), `housecall_pro_add_job_line_item` and `housecall_pro_add_job_note`. To find a free slot first: `housecall_pro_get_schedule_windows` and `housecall_pro_get_booking_windows`.
- Invoices and money owed: `housecall_pro_list_invoices` (status `open`, due dates, amount due) and `housecall_pro_get_invoice`. The connector reads invoices only; it never takes, refunds or records payments.
- Sales: `housecall_pro_list_estimates`, `housecall_pro_get_estimate`, `housecall_pro_list_estimate_option_line_items`, `housecall_pro_create_estimate`; leads with `housecall_pro_list_leads`, `housecall_pro_get_lead`, `housecall_pro_create_lead` and `housecall_pro_list_lead_sources`.
- Price book and setup: `housecall_pro_list_price_book_services`, `housecall_pro_list_material_categories` then `housecall_pro_list_materials`, `housecall_pro_list_tags`, `housecall_pro_list_events` (non-job calendar events).

**Writes act at once**: creating or rescheduling a job with `notify` true can text or email the customer. Show the user what will be created or changed and wait for a yes. `housecall_pro_delete_job_line_item` is installed switched off because a deleted line item cannot be restored; turn it on in the connector settings only if needed.

**Limits and gotchas**
- Housecall Pro rate limits API calls; a `429` carries a `RateLimit-Reset` header (Unix time). Adding line items one by one is limited per job, so add a few at a time.
- `housecall_pro_update_job_schedule` refuses jobs with several appointments; change those visits through the appointments.
- `tags` on `housecall_pro_update_customer` replaces the whole tag list.
- Invoice ids for `housecall_pro_get_invoice` come from the `id` field of `housecall_pro_list_invoices` or `housecall_pro_list_job_invoices`.
prerequisites: A Housecall Pro account on the MAX plan (the only plan with API access) and an Admin user who creates an API key in My Apps > All Apps > API Key Management.

HOUSECALL_PRO_API_KEY.label: API key
HOUSECALL_PRO_API_KEY.help: As an Admin in Housecall Pro: My Apps > All Apps > API Key Management > Generate API Key. Choose Full access for the create and update tools. Paste the key only, without the word Token. Needs the MAX plan.
HOUSECALL_PRO_API_KEY.patternMessage: Paste only the key: letters and digits, without 'Token' or spaces.

verifyHints.401: Housecall Pro refused the API key. Generate a new one in My Apps > All Apps > API Key Management (Admin only) and paste it without the word Token. API access also stops when the account leaves the MAX plan.
verifyHints.403: The key works but may not do this. A Read-only key cannot create or update; generate a Full access key for writes.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Housecall Pro is rate limiting this key. Wait until the time in the RateLimit-Reset header and try again.

tools.name: housecall_pro_get_company
tools.description: Get the Housecall Pro company: name, support email, phone, address, time zone, default arrival window, service areas and its locations (ids for the location_ids filters). Start here to check the connection.

tools.name: housecall_pro_list_employees
tools.description: List the active employees (pros, technicians, office staff) with id, name, email, mobile number, role and color. Employee ids are used to filter jobs, estimates and leads, to assign jobs and to dispatch appointments.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. The answer carries total_pages; stop when page equals total_pages.

page_size.description: Rows per page. Housecall Pro returns 10 when left out; up to 100 keeps the number of calls low.

sort_by.description: Employee field to sort by, for example created_at (default) or first_name.

location_ids.description: Only these locations (multi-location accounts). Location ids are listed in housecall_pro_get_company under locations.

tools.name: housecall_pro_list_customers
tools.description: List or search customers. q searches name, email, mobile number and address. Each customer carries id, names, company, email, phone numbers, tags, lead source, notification setting and addresses (with address ids for jobs and estimates).

q.description: Search text: name, email, mobile number or address.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. The answer carries total_pages; stop when page equals total_pages.

page_size.description: Rows per page. Housecall Pro returns 10 when left out; up to 100 keeps the number of calls low.

sort_by.description: Customer field to sort by, for example created_at or updated_at.

location_ids.description: Only these locations (multi-location accounts). Location ids are listed in housecall_pro_get_company under locations.

expand.description: Extra data to include: attachments, do_not_service.

tools.name: housecall_pro_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id with contact details, tags, lead source, notes and addresses.

expand.description: Extra data to include: attachments, do_not_service.

tools.name: housecall_pro_list_customer_addresses
tools.description: List the addresses of a customer (service and billing) with id, street, city, state, zip and country. The address id is needed to create a job or an estimate.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. The answer carries total_pages; stop when page equals total_pages.

page_size.description: Rows per page. Housecall Pro returns 10 when left out; up to 100 keeps the number of calls low.

tools.name: housecall_pro_create_customer
tools.description: Create a customer. At least one of first_name, last_name, email, mobile_number, home_number or work_number is required. Addresses can be created in the same call. Check with housecall_pro_list_customers first to avoid duplicates.

company.description: Company name, for a business customer.

notifications_enabled.description: Whether the customer receives Housecall Pro notifications (texts and emails about jobs).

addresses.description: Addresses to create with the customer. Each needs street, city, state, zip and country (for example US); street_line_2 is optional.

tools.name: housecall_pro_update_customer
tools.description: Update a customer: names, company, email, phone numbers, notification setting, tags, lead source or notes. Send only the fields to change; tags replaces the whole tag list.

company.description: Company name, for a business customer.

notifications_enabled.description: Whether the customer receives Housecall Pro notifications (texts and emails about jobs).

tools.name: housecall_pro_list_jobs
tools.description: List jobs with filters on scheduled start and end, customer, assigned employees and work status. Each job has id, invoice number, description, customer, address, work_status, schedule, assigned employees, tags, lead source, job fields and amounts in cents (total_amount, subtotal, outstanding_balance).

scheduled_start_min.description: Only jobs starting at or after this time, ISO 8601 date-time such as 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.

scheduled_start_max.description: Only jobs starting at or before this time, ISO 8601 date-time such as 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.

scheduled_end_min.description: Only jobs ending at or after this time, ISO 8601 date-time such as 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.

scheduled_end_max.description: Only jobs ending at or before this time, ISO 8601 date-time such as 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.

customer_id.description: Only jobs of this customer id.

employee_ids.description: Only jobs assigned to these employee ids.

work_status.description: Only these work statuses. All statuses when left out.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. The answer carries total_pages; stop when page equals total_pages.

page_size.description: Rows per page. Housecall Pro returns 10 when left out; up to 100 keeps the number of calls low.

location_ids.description: Only these locations (multi-location accounts). Location ids are listed in housecall_pro_get_company under locations.

expand.description: Extra data to include: attachments, appointments.

tools.name: housecall_pro_get_job
tools.description: Get one job by id: customer, address, notes, work_status, work timestamps (on my way, started, completed), schedule, assigned employees, tags, job fields, amounts in cents and the estimate it came from.

expand.description: Extra data to include: attachments, appointments.

tools.name: housecall_pro_list_job_line_items
tools.description: List the line items of a job (services, materials, discounts): id, name, description, quantity, unit_price and unit_cost in cents, amount, kind, taxable and order. The whole list comes in one answer under data.

tools.name: housecall_pro_list_job_appointments
tools.description: List the appointments (visits) of a job: id, start and end time, anytime flag, arrival window and dispatched employee ids. Multi-day jobs have several.

tools.name: housecall_pro_list_job_invoices
tools.description: List the invoices of one job with invoice number, status, amounts in cents, due and paid dates and the invoice id (uuid) for housecall_pro_get_invoice.

tools.name: housecall_pro_create_job
tools.description: Create a job for an existing customer and address, optionally scheduled and assigned, with line items, tags, notes, lead source and job type. Money in cents. Scheduling with notifications on can text or email the customer; confirm the details with the user first.

address_id.description: Address id from housecall_pro_list_customer_addresses or the customer's addresses.

invoice_number.description: Job (invoice) number, unique in the company. Left out: Housecall Pro assigns the next one.

schedule.description: Schedule the job now; leave out for an unscheduled job. scheduled_start and scheduled_end as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS (2026-11-23T15:30:00), arrival_window in minutes, or anytime true with anytime_start_date YYYY-MM-DD.

assigned_employee_ids.description: Employee ids to assign, from housecall_pro_list_employees.

unit_price.description: Selling price of one unit in cents.

unit_cost.description: Cost of one unit in cents (job costing).

line_items.description: Line items, each with name and optionally description, unit_price and unit_cost in cents and quantity.

job_fields.description: Job type and business unit, as {"job_type_id": "..."}; ids from housecall_pro_list_job_types.

tools.name: housecall_pro_update_job_schedule
tools.description: Schedule or reschedule a job: start and end time, arrival window and dispatched employees, optionally notifying the customer and the employees. Jobs with several appointments (multi-day) cannot be changed here. Confirm with the user before notifying the customer.

notify.description: Notify the customer of the new schedule.

tools.name: housecall_pro_add_job_line_item
tools.description: Add one line item to a job: name, description, quantity, unit price and unit cost in cents, kind and taxable flag. Rate limited per job; add a few at a time.

unit_price.description: Selling price of one unit in cents: 12500 = 125.00.

unit_cost.description: Cost of one unit (job costing) in cents: 12500 = 125.00.

service_item_id.description: Price book item id the line is based on, if any.

tools.name: housecall_pro_delete_job_line_item
tools.description: Delete one line item from a job. It cannot be restored. Installed switched off; show the user the line item and ask before calling.

tools.name: housecall_pro_create_job_appointment
tools.description: Add an appointment (visit) to a job, for multi-day work: start and end time, arrival window and the employees dispatched to it.

dispatched_employees_ids.description: Employee ids to dispatch, from housecall_pro_list_employees.

tools.name: housecall_pro_add_job_note
tools.description: Add an internal note to a job, visible to the team in Housecall Pro.

tools.name: housecall_pro_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices across all jobs, filtered by status, customer, created, due and paid dates, amount due and payment method. Each has id (uuid), job_id, invoice number, status, amounts in cents (amount, due_amount), due and paid dates. Read only: this connector does not take or refund payments.

customer_uuid.description: Only invoices of these customer ids.

created_at_min.description: Created at or after, ISO 8601 date-time such as 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.

created_at_max.description: Created at or before, ISO 8601 date-time such as 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.

due_at_min.description: Due at or after, ISO 8601 date-time such as 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.

due_at_max.description: Due at or before, ISO 8601 date-time such as 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.

paid_at_min.description: Paid at or after, ISO 8601 date-time such as 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.

paid_at_max.description: Paid at or before, ISO 8601 date-time such as 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.

payment_method.description: Only invoices paid with these methods.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. The answer carries total_pages; stop when page equals total_pages.

page_size.description: Rows per page. Housecall Pro returns 10 when left out; up to 100 keeps the number of calls low.

location_ids.description: Only these locations (multi-location accounts). Location ids are listed in housecall_pro_get_company under locations.

tools.name: housecall_pro_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by its id (uuid) with line items, taxes, discounts, payments and amounts in cents.

invoice_id.description: Invoice id from housecall_pro_list_invoices or housecall_pro_list_job_invoices (the id field).

tools.name: housecall_pro_list_estimates
tools.description: List estimates with filters on schedule, customer, assigned employees and work status. Each estimate has id, estimate number, customer, address, schedule, assigned employees and its options (each option with status, approval status and total in cents).

scheduled_start_min.description: Only estimates starting at or after this time, ISO 8601 date-time such as 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.

scheduled_start_max.description: Only estimates starting at or before this time, ISO 8601 date-time such as 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.

scheduled_end_min.description: Only estimates ending at or after this time, ISO 8601 date-time such as 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.

scheduled_end_max.description: Only estimates ending at or before this time, ISO 8601 date-time such as 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.

customer_id.description: Only estimates of this customer id.

employee_ids.description: Only estimates assigned to these employee ids.

work_status.description: Only these work statuses. All statuses when left out.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. The answer carries total_pages; stop when page equals total_pages.

page_size.description: Rows per page. Housecall Pro returns 10 when left out; up to 100 keeps the number of calls low.

location_ids.description: Only these locations (multi-location accounts). Location ids are listed in housecall_pro_get_company under locations.

tools.name: housecall_pro_get_estimate
tools.description: Get one estimate by id with customer, address, schedule, assigned employees, estimate fields and every option (name, status, approval status, total in cents).

tools.name: housecall_pro_list_estimate_option_line_items
tools.description: List the line items of one estimate option: name, description, quantity, unit price and cost in cents, kind and taxable flag.

option_id.description: Option id from the options of housecall_pro_get_estimate.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. The answer carries total_pages; stop when page equals total_pages.

page_size.description: Rows per page. Housecall Pro returns 10 when left out; up to 100 keeps the number of calls low.

tools.name: housecall_pro_create_estimate
tools.description: Create an estimate for an existing customer, with one or more options (each with a name and line items in cents), an address (address_id or a new address), assigned employees, a note, a message to the customer, tax and job type. Creating it does not send it to the customer.

address_id.description: Existing address id of the customer. Or give address instead.

address.description: A new address for the estimate, when there is no address_id.

options.description: Estimate options, for example Good / Better / Best. Each has a name, optional tags and line_items (name, description, unit_price and unit_cost in cents, quantity).

unit_price.description: Selling price of one unit in cents.

unit_cost.description: Cost of one unit in cents (job costing).

estimate_number.description: Estimate number, unique in the company. Left out: assigned automatically.

message.description: Message to the customer shown on the estimate.

estimate_fields.description: Job type and business unit, as {"job_type_id": "..."}; ids from housecall_pro_list_job_types.

tools.name: housecall_pro_list_leads
tools.description: List leads (potential work not yet an estimate or job) filtered by status, customer, employees, tags and lead source. Each has id, number, customer, address, lead source, tags, assigned employee, status (open, won, lost) and pipeline status.

customer_id.description: Only leads of this customer id.

employee_ids.description: Only leads assigned to these employee ids.

tag_ids.description: Only leads with these tag ids.

lead_source.description: Only leads from these lead sources.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. The answer carries total_pages; stop when page equals total_pages.

page_size.description: Rows per page. Housecall Pro returns 10 when left out; up to 100 keeps the number of calls low.

location_ids.description: Only these locations (multi-location accounts). Location ids are listed in housecall_pro_get_company under locations.

tools.name: housecall_pro_get_lead
tools.description: Get one lead by id with customer, address, lead source, tags, assigned employee, status and pipeline status.

tools.name: housecall_pro_create_lead
tools.description: Create a lead for an existing customer (customer_id) or a new one (customer with name, email or phone), with address, lead source, tags, assigned employee, note and line items in cents. Search customers first to avoid duplicates.

customer_id.description: Existing customer id. Either this or customer is required.

customer.description: A new customer, when there is no customer_id: first_name, last_name, email, mobile_number, company and other customer fields.

address_id.description: Existing address id of the customer.

address.description: A new address, when there is no address_id.

unit_price.description: Selling price of one unit in cents.

unit_cost.description: Cost of one unit in cents (job costing).

line_items.description: Requested services or materials, with prices in cents.

tools.name: housecall_pro_list_lead_sources
tools.description: List the lead sources defined in the account (where customers and jobs come from, for example Google or Referral), searchable by name. Use the names for lead_source fields and filters.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. The answer carries total_pages; stop when page equals total_pages.

page_size.description: Rows per page. Housecall Pro returns 10 when left out; up to 100 keeps the number of calls low.

tools.name: housecall_pro_get_schedule_windows
tools.description: Get the business hours and bookable windows the company configured: availability buffer in days and, per weekday, the time windows when work can be booked.

tools.name: housecall_pro_get_booking_windows
tools.description: Get open booking windows for the coming days (7 by default) from the Online Booking settings and the employees' free time. Filter by service, price form or employees, or set the window length in minutes.

start_date.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS. Default: the next day with an open window.

show_for_days.description: Number of days to show. Default 7.

service_id.description: Price book service id: only employees assigned to it, with its configured duration.

service_duration.description: Window length in minutes; overrides the service duration.

price_form_id.description: Only employees assigned to this price form.

tools.name: housecall_pro_list_price_book_services
tools.description: List or search the price book services (name, description, task number, price and cost in cents, duration, category, online booking and taxable flags). q searches name, description and task number.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. The answer carries total_pages; stop when page equals total_pages.

page_size.description: Rows per page. Housecall Pro returns 10 when left out; up to 100 keeps the number of calls low.

sort_by.description: Field to sort by, for example created_at (default) or name.

tools.name: housecall_pro_list_material_categories
tools.description: List price book material categories: the root categories, or the subcategories of parent_uuid. Category uuids are needed to list materials.

parent_uuid.description: Parent category uuid. Left out: root categories.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. The answer carries total_pages; stop when page equals total_pages.

page_size.description: Rows per page. Housecall Pro returns 10 when left out; up to 100 keeps the number of calls low.

tools.name: housecall_pro_list_materials
tools.description: List the price book materials in one material category: name, part number, description, price and cost in cents, unit of measure and taxable flag.

material_category_uuid.description: Material category uuid id from housecall_pro_list_material_categories.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. The answer carries total_pages; stop when page equals total_pages.

page_size.description: Rows per page. Housecall Pro returns 10 when left out; up to 100 keeps the number of calls low.

tools.name: housecall_pro_list_job_types
tools.description: List the job types defined in the account (for example Install, Repair, Maintenance), optionally filtered by name. The id goes into job_fields.job_type_id (jobs) or estimate_fields.job_type_id (estimates).

tools.name: housecall_pro_list_tags
tools.description: List the tags of the account (id and name), used on customers, jobs, estimates and leads.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. The answer carries total_pages; stop when page equals total_pages.

page_size.description: Rows per page. Housecall Pro returns 10 when left out; up to 100 keeps the number of calls low.

tools.name: housecall_pro_list_events
tools.description: List calendar events (blocked time that is not a job, such as meetings or time off) with name, schedule and assigned employees.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. The answer carries total_pages; stop when page equals total_pages.

page_size.description: Rows per page. Housecall Pro returns 10 when left out; up to 100 keeps the number of calls low.

sort_by.description: Field to sort by, for example created_at.

location_ids.description: Only these locations (multi-location accounts). Location ids are listed in housecall_pro_get_company under locations.
